title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Bugatti Veyron
description:
The Bugatti Veyron has two secrets that most people never hear. First, at full speed it drinks fuel so fast that its tank is empty in minutes. Second, it can only reach its top speed with a special key, and the car checks itself before it will let you use it. Behind both sits a third surprise: the sources disagree on some of the basic numbers. Here is what we found, with every claim sourced. The series today is about exotic cars, not only American ones, and Wikipedia says the Veyron belongs to the Volkswagen Group. We use Wikipedia, Top Gear, Car magazine, Motor One and Jalopnik. Where two sources give different numbers, we show both. Where we do the arithmetic, we label it as ours. And where a figure is a claim, we call it a claim.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
